idea-plugin.name: MapPeek
idea-plugin.description:
MapPeek detects the Map request and response fields of Java endpoints and turns them into API documentation your frontend can use right away.

Standard documentation tools render Map<String, Object> as an empty object, so the frontend sees no fields at all. MapPeek extracts the fields straight from source code, lets you confirm them inside the IDE, and exports in one click:

  • Understands map.put literals, constant keys and Map.of, including nested Maps and List<Map>
  • Expands entity / DTO / VO / record parameters and return types, reading @Schema, @ApiModelProperty, JavaDoc and validation annotations, with getter fallback
  • Resolves MyBatis column aliases from both @Select annotations and XML mappers
  • Reads @Operation, @ApiOperation, @Tag and custom annotations to fill endpoint titles and groups
  • Edit field descriptions directly in the tool window with live preview; saving regenerates the docs
  • Copy standard JSON Schema or OpenAPI 3.0 in one click and import it into Apifox / YApi / Postman

Source code is only read: no compilation, no container startup, no changes to business files. The only write is the .mappeek directory in the project root.

中文

MapPeek 自动识别 Java 接口里的 Map 入参与出参，生成可直接交付给前端的接口文档。

标准文档工具遇到 Map<String, Object> 只能渲染成空对象，前端看不到任何字段。 MapPeek 直接从源码提取字段，在 IDE 内确认后一键导出：

  • 识别 map.put 字面量、常量 key、Map.of，支持嵌套 Map 与 List<Map>
  • 参数或返回值是实体 / DTO / VO / record 时自动展开字段，读取 @Schema、@ApiModelProperty、JavaDoc 与校验注解，字段无注解时回退到 getter
  • 解析 MyBatis 列别名，覆盖 @Select 注解与 XML mapper
  • 识别 @Operation、@ApiOperation、@Tag 与自定义注解，自动填充接口标题与分组
  • 工具窗口内直接编辑字段说明，实时预览，保存即重新生成文档
  • 一键复制标准 JSON Schema 或 OpenAPI 3.0，可直接导入 Apifox / YApi / Postman

只读取源码，不编译、不启动容器、不修改业务文件。唯一写入是项目根目录下的 .mappeek。
